hypothesis: With the same bounded transport-reliability policy applied to both arms, the identifier-aware shortlist improves native source-context accuracy while reducing known model tokens and elapsed arm time against native convergence on untouched 8K tasks.
selection_rule: Project only the eight source-only parquet columns; exclude previously used G01 task IDs; from the hash-ordered eligible list choose one code-term-bearing task per pinned repository and verify each base commit in its pinned cache. Do not inspect gold_context, patch, or test_patch before freeze.
decision_rule: Run and report all four matched pairs. Apply the same frozen transport-reliability policy to both arms. Seal every final prediction or exact completed no-final-context result before pinned native scoring. Assign zero Span/File-F1 only to exact completed instrument.no-final-context attempts with known model-token receipts; provider and infrastructure errors invalidate a pair. Aggregate pass requires all four pairs valid, candidate macro Span-F1 and File-F1 strictly above control, total known model tokens and duration strictly below control, and at most one Span-F1 regression. Report each task outcome and recovery activation count per arm.
claim_ceiling: Four-task prospective G01 comparison with shared transport reliability; not full ContextBench or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
